title: Tiny, cute book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='cover' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d94b6d'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='page' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6dc'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe9b0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- back cover shadow edge -->
  <rect x='30' y='32' width='44' height='38' rx='4' fill='#a83450'/>

  <!-- back cover top spine peeking -->
  <rect x='30' y='32' width='44' height='38' rx='4' fill='url(#cover)'/>

  <!-- right page block -->
  <rect x='52' y='34' width='20' height='34' rx='2' fill='url(#page)'/>
  <rect x='52' y='34' width='3' height='34' fill='#f2d590'/>

  <!-- left page block -->
  <rect x='32' y='34' width='19' height='34' rx='2' fill='url(#page)'/>
  <rect x='48' y='34' width='3' height='34' fill='#f2d590'/>

  <!-- spine line between pages -->
  <rect x='49.5' y='34' width='3' height='34' fill='#e8c878'/>

  <!-- left page text lines -->
  <rect x='35' y='40' width='13' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9a24d'/>
  <rect x='35' y='45' width='13' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9a24d'/>
  <rect x='35' y='50' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9a24d'/>
  <rect x='35' y='55' width='13' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9a24d'/>
  <rect x='35' y='60' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9a24d'/>

  <!-- right page text lines -->
  <rect x='56' y='40' width='13' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9a24d'/>
  <rect x='56' y='45' width='11' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9a24d'/>
  <rect x='56' y='50' width='13' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9a24d'/>
  <rect x='56' y='55' width='9' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9a24d'/>
  <rect x='56' y='60' width='12' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9a24d'/>

  <!-- cute little heart on right page -->
  <path d='M61 66 c-1.2-1.4-3.6-1-3.6 0.9 c0 1.4 1.8 2.6 3.6 4 c1.8-1.4 3.6-2.6 3.6-4 c0-1.9-2.4-2.3-3.6-0.9z' fill='#ff5d80'/>

  <!-- front cover edge (bottom of book) -->
  <rect x='30' y='64' width='44' height='6' rx='3' fill='url(#cover)'/>

  <!-- bookmark ribbon -->
  <path d='M44 32 l4 0 l0 12 l-2-3 l-2 3 z' fill='#ffd23f'/>

  <!-- cover title bar decoration -->
  <rect x='33' y='35' width='4' height='26' rx='2' fill='#ff9db5'/>
</svg>
